title: Absorb the heavy slice by the factor-10 gate (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The heavy slice fits the factor-10 gate. For integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `10 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`,

```text
(p^{10})^{g-1} p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(K p - p^2) < 2^{-C p}.
```

Eight times the exponent is at most `8 p + 8 - 4 p^2`. The polynomial `4 p^2 - 8 p - 16` equals `15856` at `p = 64` and increases by `8 p - 4`, so the exponent is at most `-C p - 1`.

At `p = 64` and `g = 1`, `10 g L = 60 ≤ 64` while `16 g L = 96 > 64`, and the exponent is `-4035`. The published coefficient-9 gate remains `16 g L ≤ p`. At `p = 2` and `g = 1` the factor-10 hypothesis fails. The series bound `e < 3` gives `exp(4) < 81 < 1088`, so that slice is larger than `1`.

The `g` copies under this gate stay open. The trailing bound `p^{10}`, the section error, and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record remains `23/10000`. This answers the open question of #4526. It branches from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_SLICE_TEN_GATE` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T03:40:55Z was that commit. The pre-submit fetch, reread at 2026-10-22T03:44:15Z, was unchanged, and the four pinned blobs match. κ remains `23/10000`.
